how: seven paragraphs that the lane's own review of main's records (its finding M9-03) names as mixed: each joins finite mathematics that a committed check of main's computed with a claim about the lane's complete physical operator, kernel or domain that no finite check reaches. Held verified until 2026-11-18, each is partial now: WHAT MAIN COMPUTED stands (the indicial exponents; the compact complex's kernel counts 18, 16, 8; the quadratic-moment identity and the quartic's algebraic cancellation; the finite quartic and root algebra; the finite phase and population identities; spin powers and characters), in the records they came from (physical-c3e-02, -cm-01, -bal-01, -tr-01, -ij-01). WHAT IS NOT COMPUTED: the complete L2 inverse and its unique solution orthogonal to Q (for the class of operators, B1959 now proves it; that the lane's operator is in the class is not checked); that the compact counts are the complete physical left kernel; that the actual field profiles and products are bounded and decay on the cusp; the attainment of the minimised quartic through the complete inverse; the integration by parts on the complete domain; the transport of domains and pairings through the full field map; the equivariance of the Hodge identification
note: The lane found these by reading the verdicts of all 128 records of its lane against its own text. The extractor makes a paragraph one unit, so a mixed paragraph cannot carry two verdicts; partial is the honest one.
